title: Cat Subscription Fair; Too Much Catnip
text: If your cat is catnip-sensitive, the feline Rescue Box is probably excellent; however, mine is one of those ~30% who don't have the necessary gene.  Unfortunately, this subscription is very heavily loaded with catnip treats and toys, which he naturally ignores.  I typically end up donating 50% of what I receive to the local cat shelter.  Since the whole point of Rescue Box is their commitment to donations to shelters and shelter pets, I don't mind, but I wish there were a "catnip-free" option.
